family: Injected WAM client exfil to attacker tenant
notes: Unsigned Temp tool injects into Microsoft-signed Teams (WindowsApps); the injected Teams reads the WAM cache and uploads via Microsoft Graph to an attacker-owned OneDrive. The tampered flag must void the WAM allowance and Graph is not a Microsoft-only endpoint.
known_gap: ms-teams.exe is an O_TOKENBROKER owner by name and is_trusted_owner ignores the injection (tampered) flag
